clips.title: The story
paras: In Redridge, Battleworn Axe blades mark the Blackrock orcs invading the mountains. Marshal Marris accepts the recovered weapons in Lakeshire as proof of the threat to its people.

Blackrock reavers carry these heavy, nicked axes as they push south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge. Marshal Marris and Lakeshire's hard-pressed town watch collect the blades to confirm another marauding orc has fallen and to show how well armed the advancing warband is.

Blackrock invaders have fortified Stonewatch Keep and taken footholds in southeastern Redridge, trapping townspeople in Lakeshire. Taking their battleworn weapons reduces the arms available to the warband and clears roads for Alliance travel.
